`MM` the relied count, 24; the last `[24/24] browser-tools-prompt …`) + the `stamped <ver>  <n> pass  <m> fail` summary on stdout (`<n>` counting every relied row that counts toward verified, an absent browser-tools-prompt among them) and write `ledger/stamps.json`; exit 1 on a failing row; exit 1 with the home-state `unable:` / `hint:` pair, no step line, no summary and no log line when `check_home_tree` refuses its home, `ledger/`, `bin/` or `plugin/` before its `cli` log opens (and the same pair, exit 1, after the step lines, when `update_stamps` refuses `ledger/stamps.json`, with `detail:"strict-modes-failed"` on its `process-exit` under a parsed `VIOLA_NAME`); a run stopped by Ctrl-C or TERM kills its child with no key, removes only the probe dirs it created and its own trust record from the Claude config file, writes no stamp, leaves stdout empty, prints `unable: verify was stopped before it finished` / `hint: run viola verify again to stamp this CLI` and exits 1 (SIGKILL, a crash or a failed handler install leaves the dirs to remove by hand). `--record <dir>` also writes the scrubbed `<dir>/<ver>/<Event>.default.json` fixtures, the `<Event>.<stem>-<n>.json` dialog variants, Run B's `paste-<n>` / `compact-<n>` / `clear-<n>` framing variants, Run E's first SessionStart as `SessionStart.resume-1.json`, Run B's agents read as `Agents.recorded-1.json` (Run B's own row only) and signature-only `Screen.<phase>.json` screens (a footer or modal row whole, the input box's rule row as its rule chars alone and its prompt row as the prompt char alone, every other row empty; Run it from a folder you trust in Claude Code whose external CLAUDE.md import is answered. Against the real CLI: local only, spends tokens; CI runs it only against the fake agent's `-p/--print` mode and its `--screens --turn-stop --trusted-root --dialogs --framing --transcript --trust-config` interactive modes, under a test-owned user home whose config file is seeded empty and owner-only and named to the fake agent by `--trust-config` (every stamping verify passes `--transcript` beside `--framing`, or Run B's echo probe is skipped and the local-command-echo row fails). every relied row, `LedgerRow::relied()`: all twenty-four) unless `--unstamped` → the `--agents-mode recorded|oversize|malformed` value (default `recorded`; a stale file removed before verify) written to the `agents-mode` file beside `bin/claude`, after verify because Run B reads `claude agents --json` through that copy, and recorded as `agents_mode` in `session.json` and `supervise.json` → `viola-harness supervise` as an ordinary child (outlives `boot`; the agent-run CLI's boot leaves it untied, stopping only via `stop.request`; it hands the fake agent `--screens --trusted-root <cwd>`; the supervised wrappers of a stamped session run under a session user home seeded with an empty config) owning one portable-pty outer PTY per instance via `viola-pty` (master writer kept until the child exits, one drain thread per master).
